scope: Isolated local model evaluation; no Jarvis configuration or production code changed.

method.input_kind: Synthetic PT-BR Kokoro samples, not microphone recordings
method.warmup: Runtime startup warmup; Dora burst then Alex real-time on each backend
method.pacing: Each chunk sent only after its full recording interval elapsed
method.latency_definition: First partial from first audio interval start, not from word end; final delay after input_audio_buffer.commit. Burst timings are not live latency.
method.environment: Existing desktop services remained running; one measured real-time stream per backend; no statistical performance guarantee
